title.zh: 宽幅大字「风织万物」及英文衬线副标题 WIND & WEAVE
title.en: the large headline 风织万物 and serif subtitle WIND & WEAVE

floating_objects.zh: 梭子、纺锭、线轴、绞纱、针梳、编织样片六件相互分开的织造物件
floating_objects.en: six separate weaving objects: a shuttle, spindle, spool, yarn skein, reed comb and woven swatch

base.zh: 下部宽幅正视的几何木织机和织带平台
base.en: a broad front-facing geometric floor loom on a woven-band platform

module_patterns.zh: 条带、棋格、经纬格及彩色圆环
module_patterns.en: stripes, checkerboards, warp-and-weft grids and colored rings

rail.zh: 「纺线」「染色」「织造」三条由上至下的深墨蓝小字
rail.en: three small ink-blue labels in top-to-bottom order: 纺线, 染色, 织造

footer.en: the ink-blue date 06.20 — 06.21 at the bottom right

rules.zh: 为虚构的织造开放日制作海报。六件器物彼此分开，每件只出现一件。织机须有可辨认的经线、横梁和短块织布，作为底部大主体。右侧可放一枚无字的穿梭波纹圆徽。
rules.en: Create a poster for a fictional weaving open day. Show each of the six objects once, visibly separated. The large lower anchor is a loom with legible warp threads, crossbar and a short woven textile. An abstract, text-free shuttle-and-wave emblem may sit at the right.
rules.check: 核对六器物和织机的可辨结构。

rules.zh: 输出单张 3:5 竖幅。可读文字限于标题 风织万物、副标题 WIND & WEAVE、三条小字 纺线、染色、织造，以及底部日期 06.20 — 06.21。左栏与底部都有完整安全边。
rules.en: Deliver one 3:5 portrait poster. Limit readable text to the headline 风织万物, subtitle WIND & WEAVE, small labels 纺线, 染色, 织造, and footer date 06.20 — 06.21. Keep safe margins around the rail and footer.
rules.check: 核对文字与安全边、画幅。
